command: llvm-mc -triple=aarch64 -filetype=obj local.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: Input (LF, trailing newline): `.text` / `back:` / `  b ahead` / `here:` / `  b here` / `ahead:` / `  b back`. `back` and the first site are at 0, `here` and the second site at 4, `ahead` and the third site at 8. The plan names the same three targets (S1 = 4, S2 = 8, S3 = 0) and resolves with `pcrel_begin` + `scale(2)`, so the field values are (8 - 0) / 4 = 2, (4 - 4) / 4 = 0 and (0 - 8) / 4 = -2. Measured words: `02 00 00 14`, `00 00 00 14`, `fe ff ff 17`. llvm-mc resolves the local labels, so `llvm-readobj -r` is empty and no linker is involved.
source: Arm MRS `B` (imm26 at 0-25); byte displacements measured in EXP-0101 §3
